title: Projective Hodge lines and ordinary Iitaka subadditivity
summary: We prove the ordinary Iitaka subadditivity conjecture for surjective projective morphisms with connected fibers between smooth connected projective varieties over algebraically closed fields of characteristic zero. If F is the geometric generic fiber of $`f:X\to Z`$, then $`\kappa(X)\geq\kappa(F)+\kappa(Z)`$.
family_title: Iitaka subadditivity, variation, and logarithmic additivity

review.reason: Proves ordinary Iitaka subadditivity for projective morphisms with connected fibers.
